label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.99 Beta 4: Adds tappable graphical Nearest POI and Selected POI fields opening the POI list without GPS. Adds separately named experimental one-cell tappable variants; Karoo may ignore their rendering or taps. Existing native one-cell fields and Open POIs controller action remain. Nearest searches downloaded packs; selected tracks the saved destination and clears on confirmed arrival. Custom tiles use metres/kilometres; native fields use rider units. Retains Beta 3 swipe Favorites and first-use hint. No data migration or dependency changes. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
